comment: Prof. Mifsud clearly cares a lot about her students. Her class has a nontraditional collaborative structure that was confusing, but once you get into the class her teaching style makes more sense. Definitely a chaotic style of class, and boring if people don't participate, but not a hard class & an okay introduction to the basics of Rhetoric.

Dr. Mifsud is the best professor. Brilliant, flexible for students needs, if you need support, she will do just about anything to help you succeed, teaches hard stuff-gender violence, some may not want to learn, exacting standards, works hard to help you meet them, I never thought I could learn so much in a class, proudest grade I've earned

the best! runs a creative class where we all collaborate to shape agendas week to week based on class objectives, not like traditional class organized from day one, Dr. Mifsud works collaboratively with us in ways that can matter most to us, has a universal syllabus that allows for all kinds of diverse needs, caring, inspiring prof

collaboration pedagogy, not traditional, we move at our pace, can get confusing but prof keeps us on track, offers lots of support, is super smart and inspiring, on organization comments, traditional pedagogy is easy to be organized, this collaboration is hard, but worth it for what we are able to learn and do together, best class, best teacher

This professor's teaching style is disorganized and lacks structure. She often avoids planning class activities by claiming a passion for discussing pedagogy. As a result, the class feels chaotic. Her expectations for assignments are all over the place, but she has the potential to be an excellent professor if she reevaluates her approach.

Dr. Mifsud is a really passionate professor. But there is no structure at all in the course. She claims to have found a new pedagogy but to encourage participation, but class is ALL OVER THE PLACE. She is also controversial and likes to pick and choose when something is wrong or not. She really needs to find structure in her courses.

Dr. Misfud is definitely a hoot and a great professor. Although class may not be structured, it is definitely valuable speaking about issues that occur on campus. It was the most fun I ever had in class.

Basically jabbers for the entire class period, never has a structured class plan, is very unclear in her directions for assignments, repeats the same terms hundreds of times without ever explaining what they mean, often condescending, learned nothing in this class, needed it for my major. I recommend avoiding her at all costs.

She is by the least censored professor I have ever had at this university. Makes students feel highly uncomfortable for their views. Does not foster a safe environment and shuts down any opposing views that do not align with hers. All I have learned is that I do not want to take her again.

I thought taking a 2 hour 45 minute class once a week was a death sentence, but Dr. Mifsud is truly an amazing professor. She keeps the entire class interesting and constantly goes off on interesting tangents, which is usually bad, but when she does it she relates it to what we are learning. She convinced me to be an RHCS major. Take herconfidently

Dr. Mifsud is a passionate scholar, and I have learned so much from her. The coursework will challenge you to embrace new frames of ethics and understand rhetoric in different modes. You will come out of her classes with a new understanding of the rhetoric major.

I had previously enjoyed having Dr. Mifsud in class until she helped me with some independent research. She was very opinionated on my topic to the point of trying to hard to force the direction of the project. Not particularly open to criticism of things she believes or studies. Was not willing to let my other mentors influence my work.

An inspirational professor with a clear passion for not just the study of communication, but for academic life in general. Super nice and very approachable for help. However, she does have high expectations. Primary readings are difficult and will push you, but the end result is highly rewarding. A must for RHCS majors!

I loved having her as a professor. The reading was very difficult because it was all primary texts, but she was so passionate about the subject it was hard not to get interested. She also made sure to relate it to modern day things. She was super nice and always willing to help you out even if you admitted you had no idea what was going on.

I took Dr. Mifsud's class after all my other top class choices filled up, and I don't regret it at all! She's amazing and extremely  passionate about the subject. She's also very flexible with the way the class runs. She explains the difficult primary texts very well and will help with any questions you have.

I'm a male and conservative, and not only did I earn an A from her, but she has been a mentor of mine for several applications to conservative think tanks, helping me shape and sharpen my arguments for conservatism. She's no hater of conservative students.

Completely agree with the male and conservative comment. Don't expect anything higher than a C. She'll say that she's open to disagreement, but don't disagree, trust me. Her "passion" for the subject consists of speaking at length about nothing. Nothing at all. Eccentric ramblings as far as I could tell.  Nice person, though.

Amazing professor and person. An inspiration to learn from. Very challenging. Introduced me to ideas I had no idea I could ever think about. She assigns all primary texts for readings--really  hard stuff--but she teaches you how to read to get access to it.  Changed my whole perspective on everything this class did
The last 2 comments are not true!  She's amazingly intelligent, sincere (to all) and helpful.  How could you bash Mifsud?  heartless!
completely support the one below mine

Mifsud is a nice professor willing to lend a helping hand in completing assignments. But she is disgustingly partisan and picks "favs." If you're male and/or conservative, you're guaranteed a C but don't hope for anything higher.

VERY ENGAGING.  AMAZING SPEAKER.  THOUGHT-PROVOKING CLASSES.  DIFFICULT GRADER.  EXTREMELY COMPREHENSIVE TESTS.  EXPECTS A LOT BUT IS WILLING TO GIVE YOU TO THE HELP NECESSARY FOR SUCCESS.  YOU WILL ONLY SPEAK TWICE IN FRONT OF HER.  LOTS OF HELPFUL FEEDBACK.  AWESOME PROF.  TAKE HER IF YOU WANT TO LEARN A LOT IN A VERY ENJOYABLE MANNER.
Very passoniate
She's so awesome- definitely passionate and knows her stuff. Workload is no biggie, but she'll definitely challenge you. Very flexible and helpful, entertaining, and enjoyable.
best professor i've ever had
Brilliant, but sometimes hard to understand.  Very passionate, but can be very demanding.
No Comments
works you hard but teaches a lot
Enamored with rhetoric. Let's you know it. You had better fall in love too. Disorganized. Often late/absent. Very clear.
Terrible teacher...How can you run a class on speaking when your students only speak twice?  Also, her "passionate" explainations of rhetoric seem like so much smoke blown up my backdoor.
Incredibly passionate about teaching and learning. She's always available - we would have phone meetings at night when our schedules were packed.  An amazing woman.
Very difficult to figure out what she wants.  Grading is not terribly consistent.
Boo.
No Comments
Best professor by far... so passionate ... very challenging, but worth taking
Loves her work and loves to teach; be prepared to work your butt off
